# Test bolero commands with no module.
env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# bolero mod edit fails unless given explicit mod file argument
! bolero mod edit -json
bolero mod edit -json x.mod

# bug succeeds
[exec:echo] env BROWSER=echo
[exec:echo] bolero bug

# commands that load the package in the current directory fail
! bolero build
! bolero fmt
! bolero generate
! bolero get
! bolero install
! bolero list
! bolero run
! bolero test
! bolero vet

# clean succeeds, even with -modcache
bolero clean -modcache

# doc succeeds for standard library
bolero doc unsafe

# env succeeds
bolero env

# tool succeeds
bolero tool -n test2json

# version succeeds
bolero version

-- x.mod --
module m

-- x.go --
package main
func main() {}
